Subject: Your land dispute matter - R.C.S. No. 1967/2020

Dear Ms. Deshpande,

Thank you for meeting us on 20 January 2021 about your dispute with Lakshmi Shetty. As we understand it, relatives dispute who owns the ancestral land. The matter is listed before the Coimbatore District Court.

Our advice is to trace the chain of title through the mutation entries. Please collect the mutation entries, the partition deed and the old sale deeds and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Mrinalini Saraf
